title: Präteritum Review and lassen
summary: Extending past-tense forms and using lassen in common everyday patterns.
whyItMatters: Präteritum is frequent with sein, haben, and modal verbs, while lassen expresses permission, causation, or leaving something unchanged.

mentalModel.title: Use the common spoken past forms
mentalModel.content: In conversation, war, hatte, konnte, musste, wollte, and durfte are especially frequent.

mentalModel.title: Lassen changes who performs the action
mentalModel.content: The subject permits or arranges an action, while another person or process carries it out.

ruleBlocks.title: Prioritize high-frequency Präteritum
ruleBlocks.content: Practice war, hatte, wurde, konnte, musste, wollte, durfte, sollte, and wusste.

ruleBlocks.title: Use lassen plus bare infinitive
ruleBlocks.content: Say Ich lasse den Computer reparieren, with the action infinitive at the end.

ruleBlocks.title: Form the perfect double infinitive
ruleBlocks.content: With another infinitive, use Ich habe den Computer reparieren lassen.

examples.de: Meine erste Stelle war in einem kleinen Familienbetrieb.
examples.en: My first job was in a small family business.

examples.de: Damals musste ich oft am Wochenende arbeiten.
examples.en: At that time I often had to work on weekends.

examples.de: Ich habe meine Bewerbungsunterlagen professionell übersetzen lassen.
examples.en: I had my application documents professionally translated.

commonMistakes.reason: The action infinitive goes at the end.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ich habe den Computer repariert gelassen.
commonMistakes.correct: Ich habe den Computer reparieren lassen.
commonMistakes.reason: The perfect uses a double infinitive in this pattern.

comparisons.summary: Career histories provide common past-tense contexts.
Lassen can describe arranged improvements and changes.
